model: FIXED_HARD_SPHERES; full native far-field force/torque/stresslet plus native pair lubrication excess
secondary: NONE_RUNTIME; RMBW and RigidBodyIB audited for capability only
native_coefficients: required radius ratios generated with original upstream near/midfield scripts; no interpolation between lambda values
phase: bead center; bridge midpoint; pore (hex triangle barycenter / square cell center); 4x4 offset uniform grid (i+.5,j+.5)/4; 19 positions total
patch_shape: circular; deterministic finite lattice; center fixed independent of target phase
layers_rule: AB stagger; HEX dz=s*sqrt(2/3), shift=(b1+b2)/3; SQUARE dz=s/sqrt(2), shift=(b1+b2)/2
hard_sphere_overlap: NO; check all wall pairs and target/wall; upstream minimum s_dash=2.00001 regularizes touching diagnostic only
work_conjugate_scaling: Rhat=diag(1/sqrt(6*pi*mu*a),...,1/sqrt(8*pi*mu*a^3)) R diag(same); q order Vxyz,Oxyz; compare total and excess separately
leakage_metric: lower force/torque-free probe Vz induced by upper Fz / corresponding no-wall two-probe Vz; all fixed wall U/O/E=0; upper at z=2a, lower at bottom wall envelope minus2a; probe radius=a; zero background
phase_spread: (max-min)/abs(mean); TR signed isotropic projection; denominator floor1e-12 for exact zeros; report means std min max CV
anisotropy: directional 0,45,90 deg; (max-min)/abs(mean); rotation axis parallel plane; TR projected tangent force versus normal-cross-tangent rotation
coarse_to_fine: start beta0.5; beta0.25 next if free-space/native gates pass. Stop finer physics if beta0.25 worst core action error>0.5 AND worst phase TT spread>0.1 AND core mean-action improvement vs beta0.5 <0.05 absolute, or nonpositive matrices. Otherwise continue listed betas where memory/time preflight passes. Do not use a smaller patch to pretend fixed-extent refinement.
real_site_rule: deterministic representatives ranked by prior RMS/normal spread and spatial coverage; no per-patch tuning
budget_role: engineering stop bounds, not scientific gates; retain incomplete status without pretending measured
wall_cache: exact wall-wall M_inf block factorization; target Schur complement; native R2B wall-wall terms multiply prescribed zero motions and do not enter target rows. Verify identity against full native assembly including wall-wall lubrication before using this reuse.
